name: Documents
description: Reads your own documents aloud - text, Markdown, PDF, Word, OpenDocument, EPUB and HTML - from folders on the device or from urls.
examples: read me the document holiday plans
author: emkay-voice

settings_fields.name: rescan_minutes
settings_fields.label: Look for new documents every (minutes, 0 = only at start)

setup_notes.heading: Install
setup_notes.content:
pip install ovos-skill-documents

It needs [ovos-common-reading-pipeline-plugin](https://github.com/andlo/ovos-common-reading-pipeline-plugin) in the
intent pipeline, as every reading provider does.
